request.description:
Retrieve a paginated list of products. Supports search, category/brand filters, price ranges, and sorting. Publicly accessible.

### Query Parameters:
- `page`: Page number (default 1).
- `limit`: Items per page (default 20).
- `sortBy`: Field to sort by (`createdAt`, `price_asc`, `price_desc`, `name`).
- `search`: Search text for name or description.
- `status`: Filter by status (`ACTIVE`, `PENDING`, `DRAFT`, `ARCHIVED`).
- `brandId`: Filter by brand UUID.
- `categoryId`: Filter by category UUID.
- `priceMin` / `priceMax`: Price range bounds.

Create a new product. Requires `ADMIN` or `MANAGER` role.

Pricing is variant-wise — `Product` itself has no `sku`/`price`. Every product needs at least one color and at least one variant.

### Fields:
- `name`: Product name (required, 2-200 chars).
- `description`: Detailed description (optional, max 5000 chars).
- `specifications`: Shared spec sheet across all variants — display, processor, battery, camera, etc. (optional object).
- `brandId`: Associated Brand ID (required, UUID).
- `categoryIds`: Array of associated Category IDs (optional, UUIDs).
- `metadata`: Custom key-value pairs / SEO fields (optional).
- `colors`: Array of colors (required, min 1). Each has `name` (required), `hexCode` (optional swatch color), `sortOrder` (optional), and `tempKey` — a client-chosen key so `variants[].colorTempKey` can reference a color created in the same request (since it has no id yet).
- `variants`: Array of sellable variants (required, min 1). Each has `sku` (optional, auto-generated if omitted), `price` (required), `compareAtPrice` (optional MRP for strikethrough pricing), `attributes` (required object, e.g. storage/RAM — color is NOT part of attributes anymore), `colorTempKey` (references a color from this request) or `colorId` (references an existing color, used on update), `isDefault` (optional, exactly one variant must end up default — the first is auto-promoted if none is marked), `isActive` (optional, default true).
Create multiple products in a single transaction. Same per-product shape as `Create Product` (each entry needs `colors` and `variants`).

Update an existing product, its colors, and its variants. `colors`/`variants` are full-replacement syncs when supplied — any existing color/variant not included (by omitting its `id`) is deleted, so re-send every color/variant you want to keep alongside any changes. A product must always end up with at least one color and one variant. New variants during an update reference their color via `colorId` (existing) or `colorTempKey` (a color being created in the same request).

Add a new color to an existing product. Requires `ADMIN` or `MANAGER` role.

### Fields:
- `name`: Color name, unique per product (required).
- `hexCode`: Hex swatch color, e.g. `#6B5B95` (optional).
- `sortOrder`: Display order among the product's colors (optional).
- `imageIds`: Pre-uploaded `ProductImage` IDs to attach to this color's gallery (optional).
Update a color's name, hex swatch, sort order, or gallery image set. Requires `ADMIN` or `MANAGER` role.

Delete a color from a product, along with its images and variants (cascade). Requires `ADMIN` or `MANAGER` role. Blocked if this is the product's only remaining color, or if it holds the product's only remaining variants.

query.description: Optional Color ID to associate the uploaded images with a specific color's gallery. Omit for generic/lifestyle images not tied to a color.

request.description:
Full-text product search with facet aggregations using Elasticsearch. Does not require authorization.

### Query Parameters:
- `query`: Text search term.
- `brands`: Comma-separated brand IDs.
- `categories`: Comma-separated category IDs.
- `priceMin` / `priceMax`: Price range bounds.
- `rating`: Min rating (1 to 5).
- `inStock`: Only return items in stock (`true` or `false`).
- `sortBy`: Sorting field (`relevance`, `price_asc`, `price_desc`, `newest`, `rating`).
- `page` / `limit`: Pagination parameters.

request.description: Returns up to 8 product name suggestions for prefix queries. Used for real-time search autocomplete boxes.
Retrieve the current stock level, reserved quantity, and SKU for a single variant. Publicly accessible.
Retrieve stock levels for every variant of a product (array, one entry per stocked variant). Publicly accessible.

Reserve a specified quantity of inventory for an order or a checkout session. Typically called service-to-service by order or cart services.

### Fields:
- `productId`: ID of the product.
- `variantId`: ID of the variant (required — every sellable unit is a variant).
- `quantity`: Quantity to reserve (integer > 0).
- `referenceId`: UUID representing the booking resource (e.g. order ID).
- `referenceType`: Context of the reservation (e.g. `ORDER`).
Confirm a previously held inventory reservation when checkout/payment is completed. Decreases stock permanently and frees the reservation hold.
Release a previously held inventory reservation when checkout fails, is cancelled, or times out. Restores the reserved quantity back to available stock.

Restock inventory count for a variant. Requires `ADMIN` or `MANAGER` authentication.

### Fields:
- `productId`: ID of the product.
- `variantId`: ID of the variant (required).
- `quantity`: Quantity to add to stock (integer >= 0).
- `sku`: Required the first time inventory is initialised for this variant; ignored afterwards.

Perform bulk inventory update including setting low stock alert thresholds. Requires `ADMIN` or `MANAGER` role.

### Fields:
- `productId`: Product unique ID.
- `variantId`: Variant ID (required).
- `quantity`: Current physical count.
- `sku`: Stock Keeping Unit string identifier.
- `threshold`: Optional warning threshold for low stock alert notifications.

request.description: Retrieve paginated list of offers. Public endpoint.
Retrieve detailed information of a single offer by its ID. Public endpoint.

Create a new promotional campaign or discount. Requires `ADMIN` or `MANAGER` role.

### Fields:
- `name`: Campaign name.
- `type`: Offer type (`PERCENTAGE`, `FIXED_AMOUNT`, `FLASH_SALE`, `BOGO`, `TIERED`, `FREE_SHIPPING`).
- `value`: Numerical value of discount (e.g. percentage or fixed value).
- `maxDiscount`: Max ceiling cap for percentage discount (optional).
- `startAt` / `endAt`: Valid UTC ISO dates.
- `usageLimit` / `perUserLimit`: Limit counters.
- `minOrderAmount`: Order basket minimum to trigger discount.
- `applicability`: Target scope (`STORE`, `BRAND`, `CATEGORY`, `PRODUCT`, `VARIANT`).
- `applicableIds`: ID list of category/product/brand/variant records.
- `flashSaleStock`: Object with `totalStock` (mandatory for `FLASH_SALE` type).
- `couponCodes`: Associated unique code objects (optional).
Update an existing offer. Supports partial patches. Requires `ADMIN` or `MANAGER` role.
Disable/Deactivate an offer (soft delete/disable status). Requires `ADMIN` role.
Evaluate basket items and subtotal to return the best applicable promotion/coupon. Protected by `JwtAuthGuard` to prevent public DoS on this DB-heavy endpoint.
Reserve stock for a flash sale offer. Decrements flash sale inventory pool temporarily.
Confirm flash sale stock purchase. Finalizes stock reduction.
Release reserved flash sale stock reservation (restores pool stock).
